Every one of my finds so far has been completely unexpected. I'll be honest and say I do try to get the delivery schedules and info like that so I can go early in the morning and get some boxes, but every time I am told a day, I show up and they say we don't have a delivery today, so I just gave up on that. What I do is ask the employees if they have any more in the back; sometimes they do and sometimes they don't. Overall, it's a hit and miss game for me at least.

I mean, you could watch online videos and see all these people raid pallet after pallet after dump bin and get 10, 15, or even 30 rare finds a week, but all that's going to do is frustrate you.

My best advice for you is just take it easy, don't look for rare finds, let them find you. Five of my nine wild finds were when I was just looking for another mainline item and happened to run into a rare one.

Another thing I've begun to do is just buy them from an online marketplace. Now let me explain why...

First off, I own a performance car with a V8 engine, and the thing gets 15 miles to the gallon when I drive conservatively (which I rarely do 😂), so after a day of hunting, hitting about 10 or 15 stores, I'll be needing gas, which adds another 30 or 40 dollars wasted, plus the miles I put on the car, plus the time I wasted looking for a rare find.

My second vehicle is a pickup truck with a V6 engine, and you'd expect this thing to get better gas mileage, but it doesn't—14 miles to the gallon 😂. So if I take this around for a day, it eats up 50 to 60 dollars in gas!

So instead of spending that much money and wasting that much time, I'd rather just buy it from an online marketplace for $20 and get it within a few days.

$20 is the maximum I'll ever spend on a rare find, even for something like a special edition vehicle.

So my best advice is to stop looking for rare finds; not only is it going to drive you crazy, but you'll lose WAY more than you'll ever gain.

Happy hunting!

Hello!

I'd like to start off by saying thank you for doing this! I was just going to post my own giveaway tomorrow.

Okay, so let me start at the beginning. When I was a child, I had an obsession with ANY kind of vehicle, whether it be a car, truck, semi, jet, bus, or even a toaster on wheels, I JUST NEEDED IT! One of my earliest memories is from my days in kindergarten. We had a 100 days of school show and tell project. Students were required to bring in 100 of something... guess what I chose? That's right, 100 different miniature cars! Imagine a short, chubby 5-year-old walking into school with 5 bags full of miniature cars 😂 and from there it just got better! I don't remember much, but by the time I was 14, I had lost interest in toys... well, actually I wouldn't say "lost interest," it was more like financial issues. In all honesty, my parents had just bought a house, my mom started going back to school to become a nurse, and my dad had opened his first store (which at the time wasn't doing well), so I had to put my hobbies and interests to the side for a bit. Plus, I already had around 4 or 5 hundred loose cars EVERYWHERE! So by 16, financially we were in a much better place, but I moved on to gaming. What I mean by that is instead of playing with cars on a carpet, I started to play racing games with friends I made online. That same year, my dad thought since I was "too old" for toys, he could pack them up, which I was fine with... what he didn't tell me was he was going to mail them all to another state, where my younger cousin lives. So that pretty much ended my collecting.

Fast forward to March of 2015, I bought my first car at 19, a 2011 model, and she was properly named. After getting this, I was determined to find a scale model of my car. While looking online, I ran into an article that said a popular toy company was going to release a 2015 model of a well-known sports car. I now wanted that car no matter what 😂. So after a few weeks, I finally found one on a short card; it turns out it was from a 50 car case that someone had opened and dumped out, but since I had already picked up the 3 I wanted (the sports car, a luxury sedan in a unique color, and a famous time machine), they just let me have them for free! After that, I didn't buy anything else until July of 2016 when I heard another company was releasing my exact car as a model! I immediately pre-ordered 4, and that's where it all started! After that, I would regularly pick up models of cars I liked. Around August, I found this community since I wanted to gain more knowledge of what was/is out there for me to collect. And the rest is history.

Oh, and the main reason I collect carded miniature cars is because my mom didn't like the mess I used to make with loose ones 😂

Okay, so now for my absolute favorite miniature car is going to have to be the 2011 model, not because it's a special edition but because the 2011 model was and still is my first car! This car, no matter what, will put a smile on my face as soon as I put my foot down and hear those tires squeal! I love the model since it reminds me of the hard work I had to go through to get to where I am and afford my car.

My favorite non-miniature car is the model from the other company because it is MY CAR! This will bring up memories for the rest of my life and will always hold a special place in my collection!

TLDR: used to have tons of loose cars, dad gave them away. Lost interest until I bought my first car. After I got my car, another company released an exact 1/64 scale model. Collecting started again!

Favorite miniature car: 2011 model

Favorite non-miniature car: model from the other company
